claims.claim: Tutorial covers testing tools that execute on the caller's device, including consent simulation for grant and deny
Client-mode tools are defined with mode: client
mock_result provides deterministic test data for tools
Client tools support consent simulation configured on the tool
Link target /arena/tutorials/01-first-test/ exists
Link target /arena/tutorials/04-mcp-tools/ exists
Client-side tools execute on the caller's device; the LLM requests the call and the end user's client runs it
Client tools typically require user consent before executing
PromptArena simulates the consent flow so granted and denied permissions can be tested
Tool definition file is created at tools/get_location.tool.yaml
apiVersion is promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1
kind is Tool
metadata.name is a field of the Tool object
Tool object has a spec field
spec.description is a string field
spec.mode accepts the value client
spec.timeout_ms is an integer field and is used with value 5000
spec.input_schema is a JSON-schema object with properties
input_schema property accuracy is a string with enum [high, low] and a description
spec.output_schema is a field of the Tool spec
spec.mock_result is a field whose value is an object returned to the LLM
spec.client is an object field on the Tool spec
client.consent.required is a boolean; value true is accepted
client.consent.message is a string field
client.consent.decline_strategy accepts the value error
client.categories is a list field; the example uses the value location
mode: client marks the tool as client-side rather than server-executed
mock_result provides a fixed response when running in test mode and the LLM receives it as device data
decline_strategy: error returns an error to the LLM when consent is denied
PromptConfig file is created at prompts/chat.yaml
apiVersion is promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 for PromptConfig
kind is PromptConfig
spec.task_type field accepts the value chat
spec.version is a string field and is set to v1.0.0
spec.description is a field of PromptConfig
spec.system_template is a field of PromptConfig
spec.allowed_tools is a list field of PromptConfig
allowed_tools entry get_location references the tool by metadata name or spec name
Scenario file is created at scenarios/consent-grant.scenario.yaml
apiVersion is promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 for Scenario and kind is Scenario
spec.id is a field of Scenario
spec.task_type accepts the value chat for Scenario
spec.description is a field of Scenario
spec.turns is a list of turn objects
turn role accepts the value user
turn content is a string field
turn assertions is a list field
assertion type tool_called is a registered assertion type
assertion params accepts tool_name and message for tool_called
assertion type content_matches is a registered assertion type
assertion params accepts pattern and message for content_matches
pattern (?i)(san francisco|37\.77|location) is a valid regular expression
When no consent_overrides are specified, consent defaults to grant
The LLM calls get_location, receives mock_result data and uses it in its response
Deny scenario uses apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 and kind Scenario
turns[].consent_overrides is a field of a turn
consent_overrides maps a tool name to deny
consent_overrides with deny simulates the user declining the consent prompt
LLM responds gracefully to denial rather than crashing or ignoring the error
Arena file uses apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 and kind Arena
metadata.name is a field of Arena
spec.prompt_configs is a list of objects with id and file
prompt_configs entry id: chat
prompt_configs entry file
spec.providers is a list with file entries
providers/mock-provider.yaml is a provider file path
spec.scenarios is a list with file entries
spec.tools is a list with file entries
spec.defaults is an object field of Arena
defaults.temperature is a field set to 0.0
defaults.max_tokens is a field set to 500
defaults.seed is a field set to 42
defaults.output is an object field
defaults.output.dir is a field and the value out is accepted
defaults.output.formats accepts the values json and markdown
Arena registers the tool with the pipeline and handles consent simulation automatically from scenario overrides
Command promptarena run exists
promptarena run accepts the --ci flag
promptarena run accepts --format with the value markdown
Running from the project directory finds config.arena.yaml by default
Run output shows both scenarios executed
Scenario consent-grant calls the tool, returns mock_result, and the LLM uses the coordinates
Scenario consent-deny attempts the tool call, consent is denied, and the LLM responds with a fallback message
Results are written to out/results.md
Command promptarena serve exists and serves an interactive web UI
Summary item: client-mode tool defined with mode: client
Summary item: mock_result provides deterministic data without a device
Summary item: consent simulation configured with client.consent settings on the tool
Summary item: grant path is the default behaviour
Summary item: deny path uses consent_overrides
examples/client-tools/ directory exists in the PromptKit repository
Link target /arena/tutorials/05-ci-integration/ exists
Link target /arena/tutorials/04-mcp-tools/ exists
